items.summary: Bukayo Saka suffered a concerning thigh injury just 10 minutes into Arsenal's Champions League clash at Bayern Munich, with manager Mikel Arteta admitting it doesn't look good at all and the medical team expressing concern about the star winger's condition.

source.title: Arteta concedes Saka's injury 'doesn't look good at all'

items.summary: Declan Rice rescued a point for Arsenal with an 82nd-minute equalizer in a thrilling 2-2 draw at Bayern Munich, maintaining the Gunners' unbeaten start to their Champions League campaign after Harry Kane had put the hosts ahead from the penalty spot.

source.title: Bayern Munich 2-2 Arsenal: Rice salvages late draw to deny Kane winner

items.summary: Arsenal sit second in the Premier League with 18 points after grinding out a 1-0 win at Nottingham Forest thanks to substitute Noni Madueke's late goal, keeping them three points behind leaders Manchester City.

source.title: Arsenal 'lack stardust' but are still Premier League title favourites, says Carragher
